concepts.key_idea: You can add two integers in any order and get the same result.

concepts.title: Division of Integers
concepts.definition: Division is the inverse of multiplication. Same signs give positive quotient, different signs give negative quotient. a / (-b) = (-a) / b = -(a/b), and (-a) / (-b) = a / b.
concepts.key_idea: Same signs = positive, different signs = negative. Division is inverse of multiplication.

concepts.title: Properties of Division of Integers
concepts.definition: Integers are NOT closed under division. Division is NOT commutative. Division is NOT associative. a / 0 is not defined. 0 / a = 0 for a != 0. a / 1 = a. a / (-1) = -a.
concepts.formula: a / 0 is undefined; 0 / a = 0; a / 1 = a; a / (-1) = -a
concepts.key_idea: Division does not follow closure, commutativity, or associativity for integers.
